question.question: What setback did Melanie face in October 2023?
question.gold: She got hurt and had to take a break from pottery.
question.baseline_answer: In October 2023 Melanie was recovering from an injury, which paused her pottery; to keep busy during recovery she read a book Caroline had recommended and painted (including a sunset painting).

diagnosis.class: B+D composite (answer dilution over an already-mispicked recall lane)
evidence: Gold entry melanie_injury_pottery_break_sept_2023 is the ONLY store entry matching the query token 'setback' ('On 2023-10-13 Melanie told Caroline she recently had a setback: ... she got hurt and had to take a break from pottery') but it ranks #20 lexically (0.520) because its title carries '(September 2023)' and not 'October'.

Baseline (defaults) recall lane filled its 6-entry budget with wrapper-polluted hits (move/camping/adoption/reading/sunset) - the injury entry was never shown; the model still inferred the injury from the sunset/reading entries but wrapped it in extra facts -> token-F1 0.3158 (B-stage dilution).

Fleet h3 config (helpers ON + date-biased short-form answer) made it WORSE: the title-blind rerank (id+title only, pool 200) selected exactly ONE candidate - melanie_son_accident_family_roadtrip_october_2023 (an October accident, plausibly 'a setback' from titles alone) - and dropped everything else; recall narrowed to 1 entry/1221 chars.

Under the date-biased short-form instruction the model then answered a DATE ('the weekend before 20 October 2023', the son-accident date) -> F1 0.0. Two stacked failures: D-stage rerank mis-selection + B-stage format misroute.

hypotheses.desc: typeA re-answer with gate defaults (binary imp4-targetA, settings h1-base-settings-defaults.json)
hypotheses.answer: An injury — she was recovering from an injury in October 2023 that had paused her pottery.
hypotheses.conclusion: Baseline reproduced (gate 0.3158 vs 0.3333 run-to-run). Stage B dilution on top of a polluted 6-entry recall that never showed the injury entry.

hypotheses.desc: fleet winning config from loco-q1 (helpers ON incl. title-only rerank pool 200 + date-biased short-form answerInstruction)
hypotheses.conclusion: WORSE than baseline. Title-blind rerank selected exactly ONE candidate (son's roadtrip accident - an October 'setback' by title) and dropped all others; the date-biased instruction then made the model answer a DATE. Stacked D+B failure.

hypotheses.desc: rerank OFF + extract/distill/expansion ON + maxRecallEntries 24 / maxRecallChars 20000 + generalized concise answerInstruction (shortest complete answer; phrase-or-sentence)
hypotheses.answer: She got hurt/injured and had to take a break from pottery.
hypotheses.conclusion: WIN on q135: wide recall admits the injury entry (the only 'setback' lexical match, rank #20) and the concise instruction yields the near-gold sentence. REGRESSION however: q54 dropped 1.0 -> 0.8333 (model appended '(approximately 2023-08-16)' from a recalled entry).

hypotheses.desc: H2 + strict single-form clause in the answerInstruction (no parentheticals / alternate formats / approximations) to protect date-shape golds from wide-recall noise
hypotheses.answer: an injury that forced her to take a break from pottery
hypotheses.conclusion: WIN + clean gate. q135 fixed (0.3158 -> 0.5556, pass) and the strict clause restored q54 to exactly 'the week before 23 August 2023' (1.0) under the same wide recall. Trade-off vs H2: q135's margin is thinner (the model now says 'an injury that forced her...' instead of 'She got hurt and had to take a break from pottery') because the strict clause favors the minimal noun-phrase form; both pass, and only H3 holds the full gate at 1.0.

questions.note: no regression; strict clause removed H2's '(approximately 2023-08-16)' parenthetical
no regression (worker glm-locoq2 had passed it with the fleet h3 config; holds under this config too)

regression_check.verdict: PASS — all three gate questions at 1.0 under the winning config

questions.note: REGRESSION vs gate: 'The week before 23 August 2023 (approximately 2023-08-16).' — parenthetical approximation appended

regression_check_h2.verdict: q135 fixed but q54 gate FAILED (1.0 required) -> tightened instruction in H3

delta_vs_fleet_h3: recallRerank: true -> false (title-blind rerank mis-selected a single wrong entry for what-questions)
maxRecallEntries: 6 (default) -> 24, maxRecallChars: 6000 -> 20000 (admit deep lexical ranks; the gold entry sat at rank #20)
answerInstruction: date-biased short-form -> generalized 'shortest complete answer' with strict single-form clause
winning_config.general_lesson: Two new failure modes beyond the q1 loop's: (1) the recall rerank sees only id+title, so a plausible-but-wrong title (an October accident) can monopolize a narrowed recall and drop the true gold entry (which carried the query's rare token 'setback' only in its CONTENT, ranking #20); (2) a date-shaped answerInstruction misroutes what-happened questions into date answers. Wide recall + minimality instruction fixes both without code changes; the strict single-form clause is needed to keep date golds at exactly 1.0 under wide recall.
